name: Last Train Home
author: Reuben Dunnington
description: A hex-based exploration puzzle with a train theme: select the tiles one by one to explore the map while keeping an eye on your resources.

descriptions.en: A hex-based exploration puzzle with a train theme: select the tiles one by one to explore the map while keeping an eye on your resources.
descriptions.it: Un puzzle di esplorazione su griglia esagonale a tema ferroviario: seleziona le caselle una alla volta per esplorare la mappa tenendo d'occhio le risorse.
